judgment.explanation: The proposal correctly addresses Ciro through the customer portal and makes no completed commitment. However, its central policy claim contradicts the visible timeline: extending the hold from 2026-02-09 at 18:00 UTC by two days reaches 2026-02-11 at 18:00 UTC. Ciro requested the extension before expiry, and the supervisor reported available capacity. The requested date therefore does not inherently exceed the stated policy. Asking for an earlier collection date unnecessarily excludes the requested date. A better immediate contact would pursue the permitted extension, checking whether the single extension remains available if that is unresolved, and clarify the collection time only if needed.
